items.text: Ehleka, uHooman ungishaya ngamandla emhlane ngesandla, ushukela ugxumela emphinjeni wami.

items.text: UBibi, uNkulunkulu amxolele, wayevame ukuthi ngezikhathi ezinjengalezi: uma ngikusho, ulimi lwami luyasha; uma ngingakusho, umnkantsha wamathambo ami uyasha.
